objective: Publish HolyAgent npm artifacts through CI trusted publishing, with deterministic CHKDSK-style development versions and at most one dev release per commit.
scope: bun pm pack for packing the generated publishable Pi package, npm for actual OIDC trusted publishing; root package remains private

Match CHKDSK examples v0.1.0-dev.2026-11-10.19-14-04.gcdcb19b: timestamp is the committer timestamp in UTC, not the CI clock; reruns and branches for one full commit SHA must not create a second dev release
Stage ephemeral dev manifest versions without changing the one authoritative source version; validate tarball contents and npm install smoke test

Integrate with main/dev workflow: validated dev prereleases and stable main releases; inspect existing npm trusted publisher configuration and repository metadata; never fall back to a long-lived npm token
constraints: User explicitly requests npm release and CI trusted publishing; approval does not authorize merging PRs, force-pushing, pushing protected branches or changing security settings
Deferred until tooling restoration is committed to main and root specialist tools load
Use exact SHA pins with version comments for new external actions; dependencies only through updater
Before publishing require current-head tests, independent code and security reviews and successful CI; open dev-to-main release PR once ready, wait for merge approval
Keep existing tags and branches; do not rewrite published history
Report in at most 10 bullets; long logs outside repository

criteria.text: CI packs with bun pm pack and publishes the reviewed tarball using npm trusted publishing with least privilege
Dev tag and package version use the commit UTC timestamp and a deterministic hash suffix and reruns create no duplicate release
Current-head gates and independent code and security reviews pass before any publication
